info.name: PromiseUnlocked API
info.description:
Complete API collection for PromiseUnlocked backend (v3).

## Workflow
1. Start with **Auth > Register** or **Auth > Login** to get a Firebase ID token.
2. The **Login** / **Register** request auto-saves the token as `bearerToken` and the UID as `userId`.
3. List-type requests auto-save IDs (`participantId`, `sessionId`, `interactionId`, etc.) for chained requests.
4. Use `/participants/me/*` routes for the authenticated user's own data.
5. Use the `{{baseUrl}}` variable to switch between local dev and deployed environments.

## Environment Variables (auto-populated)
- `bearerToken` — Firebase ID token
- `userId` — Firebase Auth UID
- `participantId` — Participant document UID
- `sessionId` — Session document ID
- `interactionId` — Interaction document ID
- `jobId` — Proof / embedding job UUID
- `embeddingId` — Profile embedding document ID
- `proofStatus` — Proof verification status
- `reportId` — Help report document ID

exec: // Auto-refresh the Firebase ID token using the stored refresh token.
// Requires env: firebaseApiKey (Firebase Web API key) + refreshToken (set on Login).
// Refresh when there is no token, or it expires within 5 minutes.
console.warn('[auth] token expired but firebaseApiKey/refreshToken not set — run Login first.');
if (err) { console.error('[auth] token refresh failed:', err); return; }
